login_fast_path_limit.detail: Existing live dungeon is returned before checking ended/expiry. Absent-world branch rebuilds active quest or resolves exterior; missing quest/catalog uses configured respawn. No player owner or held-key argument is supplied at login.

proximity_uses.purpose: accepted mission binding: offered WorldPos -> static catalog entrance
proximity_uses.reason: This is the only TryFindAt caller. It is not a player-range check. Exact PF+X/Y/Z bits can resolve evidence; current lookup ignores Y and allows radius1 substitutions. The comment that it only absorbs rounding is unsupported by exact corpus evidence.
10 horizontal/14 vertical authorization range measures player proximity to an already selected identity; exact historical WorldPos matching does not invalidate this different purpose.
Triggers are baked from Dynels.dat MissionEntrance identity/position and defer to TryEnter;1.5 radius is an interaction volume rather than evidence identity matching.

return_behavior.completed: Retires keys/links but keeps current occupants until they leave; cannot re-enter/rebuild.
return_behavior.expired_abandoned: EndDungeon transfers all occupants to exact catalog entrance XYZ and releases when empty.
return_behavior.normal: Generated exit door registers return to current catalog exterior, offset along stored catalog heading by PortalDoorLandingResolver.ExitDoorClearance.
return_behavior.restart: Existing live world preserves stored position; rebuilt active world uses layout spawn; closed quest routes exterior; missing quest/catalog routes configured respawn.
